subject: Intro discovery — syncing AE/SE + Novaforge eng & procurement availability
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@novaforge.com>, Tom Wu <tom.wu@novaforge.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro discovery — syncing AE/SE + Novaforge eng & procurement availability

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks for the quick intro to Novaforge. I’m Jonas (AE) and I’ll run the discovery + initial intake. Alex (cc'd) is our Solutions Engineer and will join to handle architecture/security questions.

Goal: 45–60 minute discovery to understand your use case, data/security constraints, and the success criteria for a pilot. Also want to confirm procurement/contract steps early.

Could you confirm availability for any of the following windows next week (in PT):
- Tue 9/1, 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed 9/2, 11:00–12:00
- Thu 9/3, 15:00–16:00

If those don't work, please propose 2 slots and include who should attend from your side (champion / engineering lead / procurement).

Attached: discovery-agenda.ics (placeholder) and a short security brief we typically share ahead of discovery. If you have an internal SOC 2 / security contact, please loop them in or point me to the right person — Tom, when convenient can you also share any baseline evidence requirements Novaforge has (e.g., SOC 2 report, data residency constraints)?

Next steps: once we lock a slot I'll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and a short pre-read.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jonas.weber@redwood.com] | +1 415-555-0127
[Attachment: discovery-agenda.ics]
[Attachment: redwood-security-brief.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)]

From: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@novaforge.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@novaforge.com>, procurement@novaforge.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro discovery — syncing AE/SE + Novaforge eng & procurement availability

Jonas —

Thanks for the note. We can do Wed 9/2 11:00–12:00 PT. Attendees: me (product champion), Tom Wu (platform engineering lead), and I've looped procurement (procurement@novaforge.com) for any contract/nda questions.

A couple things up front:
- We will want to see a SOC 2 Type II report and a short runbook for data retention before any pilot. If you can share the SOC2 artifact or an equivalent statement, that helps speed procurement.
- For the discovery please bring any examples of how you handle private deploys vs hosted API routing — Tom will want to discuss network/VPC options briefly.

Confirming Wed 9/2 11:00 PT. Please send calendar invite.

Best,
Sarah Lopez
Senior PM, Novaforge
[sarah.lopez@novaforge.com]

Thanks — Wed 9/2 11:00 PT works for me. I'll plan to bring a short technical checklist (networking, auth, KV/cache behavior) and a couple example architectures (hosted vs private).

If Tom has any immediate constraints (e.g., cannot open outbound to 3rd-party APIs, or needs on-prem-only), please flag here so I can tailor the deck.

Quick update — small scheduling conflict on Alex's side: he got pulled into a customer incident for the morning of Wed 9/2.

Options:
- Move to Wed 9/2 15:00–16:00 PT (same day, later slot) — Alex confirmed availability then.
- Keep Wed 9/2 11:00 PT and have Marissa (cc'd) cover in Alex's stead for the initial intake; Alex can join the deep technical follow-up.

Which do you prefer? Procurement: if you need SOC 2 artifacts to be routed before the meeting we can get those to you today (see attachment).

If it helps, I've tentatively held Wed 9/2 15:00 PT on my calendar; I can send the invite once you confirm.
